title: From Seller Sign-Up to Marketplace Growth
summary: Unlock marketplace growth with a connected approach to seller acquisition, activation, retention, and monetization across the lifecycle.
body_markdown:
## Turn Seller Participation Into Marketplace Growth


Consumer traffic creates demand, but active sellers turn that demand into choice, transactions, and revenue. As sellers operate across more platforms, marketplaces are competing not just for shoppers, but for sellers’ continued attention and investment. The real growth challenge is moving beyond seller acquisition to create sustained marketplace value.


## Build a Seller Growth Engine That Goes Beyond Sign-Up


The seller journey begins, rather than ends, at registration. A connected operating model brings sales and seller operations together to acquire and qualify high-potential sellers, accelerate onboarding and activation, grow seller value, and create opportunities for monetization. Done well, that means stronger seller pipelines, faster time to value, greater activity and retention, and more recurring revenue from the seller base.
